concerns.text: The plan cites only generic SMILES, WebBook metadata, PubChem, and RDKit parquet files as “Verified Datasets”, none of which contain the required experimental halide binding constants (host‑SMILES + halide_identity + binding_constant). This means the primary data source required by FR‑001 is missing, making the real‑data branch of the workflow unsupportable and forcing reliance on the simulated fallback. Add a citation to a dataset that actually provides halide‑binding measurements (or acknowledge that no such open dataset exists and redesign the research question accordingly).
